candidateClauseFinalChecks.sourceEnglishParagraph: Intercropping is not just crowding different plants together. Each plant needs a job, and enough space to do it.

candidateClauseFinalChecks.provenance: unreviewed machine draft or localized-plus-English hold for facilitator feedback; not fluent approval

candidateClauseFinalChecks.sourceClause: Give them suitable space, water and light.
candidateClauseFinalChecks.priorCandidateClause: Nyika swibyariwa ndhawu, mati ni ku vonakala ka dyambu leswi swi swi faneleke.
candidateClauseFinalChecks.finalClauseOrLocalizedPrefix: Nyika swibyariwa suitable space, water and light.
candidateClauseFinalChecks.rationale: Avoids narrowing light to sunlight and preserves that all three inputs must be suitable.
candidateClauseFinalChecks.provenance: unreviewed machine draft or localized-plus-English hold for facilitator feedback; not fluent approval
